"""RAG seed scene: FeedForward NN with forward pass animation."""
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import (
    NeuralNetwork,
    FeedForwardLayer,
)


class FeedForwardNetworkScene(ThreeDScene):
    """Rich FeedForward neural network scene with title, labels, and forward pass."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0d1117"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Feedforward Neural Network", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)
        subtitle = Text(
            "Forward Pass Visualization", font_size=20, color="#58C4DD"
        )
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.12)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=0.9)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=DOWN * 0.2), run_time=0.5)

        # ── Neural network ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        nn = NeuralNetwork(
            [
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=4, node_color="#58C4DD"),
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=6, node_color="#58C4DD"),
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=6, node_color="#58C4DD"),
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=3, node_color="#10B981"),
            ],
            layer_spacing=0.3,
        )
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3)

        # Layer labels - use nn.input_layers for direct layer access
        layer_names = ["Input\n(4)", "Hidden\n(6)", "Hidden\n(6)", "Output\n(3)"]
        label_colors = ["#F59E0B", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#10B981"]
        label_group = VGroup()
        for i, (lname, lcolor) in enumerate(zip(layer_names, label_colors)):
            txt = Text(lname, font_size=14, color=lcolor)
            txt.next_to(nn.input_layers[i], DOWN, buff=0.25)
            label_group.add(txt)

        # ── Introduce architecture ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        self.play(FadeIn(nn), run_time=0.7)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Write(t) for t in label_group], lag_ratio=0.25), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Annotation: "activations flow left → right" ───────────────────────
        flow_arrow = Arrow(
            start=nn.input_layers[0].get_left() + LEFT * 0.5,
            end=nn.input_layers[-1].get_right() + RIGHT * 0.5,

            stroke_width=2,
            buff=0,
        )
        flow_arrow.next_to(nn, DOWN, buff=0.9)
        flow_label = Text("activations →", font_size=16, color="#FF862F")

        # ── Forward pass ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import (
    NeuralNetwork,
    FeedForwardLayer,
    Convolutional2DLayer,
    ImageLayer,
)
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image as PILImage


class CNNClassifierScene(ThreeDScene):
    """CNN image classifier: ImageLayer → Conv → Conv → FF output with forward pass."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0d1b2a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        # ── Build a fake 8×8 RGB input image ─────────────────────────────────
        np.random.seed(42)

        pil_img = PILImage.fromarray(img_array)

        # ── Network definition ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        nn = NeuralNetwork(
            [

        nn.scale(0.9)

        arch_labels = ["Input\nImage", "Conv1\n(1 fm)", "Conv2\n(3 fm)", "FC\n(5)", "Softmax\n(3)"]

"""RAG seed scene: ImageLayer feeding into a full CNN pipeline."""
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import (
    NeuralNetwork,
    FeedForwardLayer,
    Convolutional2DLayer,
    ImageLayer,
)
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image as PILImage


class ImageLayerCNNScene(ThreeDScene):
    """Demonstrates ImageLayer as the entry point of a neural network, flowing into Conv layers."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0e1a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("ImageLayer — Input to CNN", font_size=34, color=WHITE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.3)
        subtitle = Text("Raw image pixels enter the convolutional pipeline", font_size=17, color="#F59E0B")
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=0.5)

        # ── Generate a synthetic image (gradient pattern) ──────────────────────
        np.random.seed(7)
        h, w = 12, 12
        img_arr = np.zeros((h, w, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                img_arr[r, c] = [
                    int(255 * r / h),
                    int(255 * c / w),
                    int(128 + 64 * np.sin(r + c)),
                ]
        pil_img = PILImage.fromarray(img_arr)

        # ── Network ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        nn = NeuralNetwork(
            [
                ImageLayer(np.asarray(pil_img), height=1.5),
                Convolutional2DLayer(
                    num_feature_maps=1,
                    feature_map_size=5,
                    filter_size=3,
                    filter_spacing=0.32,
                    color="#58C4DD",
                    active_color="#FF862F",
                ),
                Convolutional2DLayer(
                    num_feature_maps=2,
                    feature_map_size=3,
                    filter_size=2,
                    filter_spacing=0.22,
                    color="#8B5CF6",
                    active_color="#FF862F",
                ),
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=4, node_color="#58C4DD"),
                FeedForwardLayer(num_nodes=2, node_color="#10B981"),
            ],
            layer_spacing=0.25,
        )
        nn.scale(0.9)
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.15)

        # ── Layer labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        arch_info = [
            ("12x12\nRGB", "#F59E0B"),
            ("Conv1\n(1 fm)", "#58C4DD"),
            ("Conv2\n(2 fm)", "#8B5CF6"),
            ("Dense\n(4)", "#FFFFFF"),
            ("Output\n(2)", "#10B981"),
        ]
        label_group = VGroup()
        for i, (lbl, col) in enumerate(arch_info):
            t = Text(lbl, font_size=13, color=col)
            t.next_to(nn.input_layers[i], DOWN, buff=0.3)
            label_group.add(t)

        # ── Callout on the ImageLayer ──────────────────────────────────────────
        img_box = SurroundingRectangle(nn.input_layers[0], color="#F59E0B", corner_radius=0.08, buff=0.1)
        img_call = Text("ImageLayer", font_size=14, color="#F59E0B")
        img_call.next_to(img_box, UP, buff=0.12)

        self.play(FadeIn(nn), run_time=0.7)
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[Write(t) for t in label_group], lag_ratio=0.2),
            run_time=0.9,
        )
        self.play(Create(img_box), Write(img_call), run_time=0.6)

        for i, (lbl, col) in enumerate(arch_info):
